comparison.objective: Return a beehive frame onto both rests and close the gap to neighbouring frames; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually lift a large frame over a wall, align two lugs onto narrow rests, release, then slide shoulders together, versus millimetre-scale tool/collar manipulation and response testing.
comparison.success_condition: Both lugs must support a level, square frame with ≤2 mm neighbour gap and no other frame displaced; candidate requires locked setting and two force/travel-bounded cycles.
comparison.reason: Large-part insertion and lateral seating test a different ability from shock-absorber tuning.
